entities.summary: Chandaneswar Temple is a famous Shiva temple located in Chandaneswar, Baleswar district of Odisha, India. A huge annual fair on the Pana Sankranti, the first day of the Odia calendar, is celebrated on the premises. Many Indian pilgrims visit the temple during this period.
